name: og-energy-proto-energetics
title: The Energy Currency
question: Can a primitive system capture environmental (geochemical) free energy into a transferable chemical currency — charged by an exergonic drive, spent on endergonic work, lost to hydrolysis — before any modern-style ion pumping, and what fraction of the geochemical free energy becomes stored usable work?
hypothesis: A pre-ATP carrier (thioester / acyl-phosphate class) coupled to an exergonic geochemical drive maintains a transferable currency above threshold under endergonic load — but only where the drive ΔG clears the carrier's high-energy bond and the coupling is efficient enough to beat discharge + hydrolysis. A bounded fraction of the geochemical free energy is captured as stored usable work; the rest is dissipated. Remove the coupling or starve the drive below the bond and the currency collapses.
objective: Represent the exergonic-to-endergonic coupling as explicit energetic bookkeeping (a free-energy ledger), not a favourable reaction direction; map where a transferable currency is maintained and measure the stored-work fraction.
proposed_mechanisms: energetics: pre-ATP energy currency (thioesters / acyl phosphates / polyphosphates)
proposed_models_methods: free-energy ledger (input = useful work + stored + dissipated) as a conservation invariant
charge / discharge / hydrolysis kinetics of a transferable carrier pool
phase map over (geochemical free-energy drive x coupling efficiency)

conditions.name: reproducibility
conditions.expr: solver and db and seed and scenario recorded

contract.note: bigraph-schema typed ports (_type/_units/bounds) + a free-energy-accounting conservation predicate; the proto_energetics composite declares a ProcessContract matching this face (audited via the workbench §Contract panel). behavior_tests.name: currency-maintained
behavior_tests.description: The carrier stays charged under continuous endergonic load — a transferable currency is MAINTAINED above threshold, not merely charged transiently.

measure.detail: charged fraction of the carrier pool at the end of the run

pass_if.detail: the currency is maintained (charged fraction >= 0.25) against discharge + hydrolysis

behavior_tests.name: captures-free-energy
behavior_tests.description: A substantial fraction of the input geochemical free energy is captured as transferable usable work (stored-work fraction), not just dissipated.

measure.detail: (delivered work + currently stored)/input free energy at the end of the run

pass_if.detail: capture into transferable currency exceeds 30% of the tapped geochemical free energy

behavior_tests.name: ablation-no-coupling-or-drive-collapses
behavior_tests.description: Feature ablation: with no coupling (coupling_efficiency -> 0) or no drive (drive ΔG below the carrier bond), the currency never charges — capturing free energy requires BOTH the coupling chemistry and a drive that clears the bond.

measure.detail: no-coupling and no-drive controls vs the favourable arm

pass_if.detail: both ablations collapse (charged fraction ~0) where the favourable arm maintains the currency

behavior_tests.name: free-energy-conserved
behavior_tests.description: Free-energy accounting is a contract invariant — input = useful work + stored + dissipated, held to machine precision every tick.

measure.detail: worst-case |input - (work + stored + dissipated)| over the run

pass_if.detail: the ledger residual stays at machine precision (free-energy accounting invariant)

literature_anchors.expectation: Pre-ATP carriers (thioesters, acyl phosphates) couple exergonic to endergonic chemistry as a transferable energy currency before membrane bioenergetics / ATP
literature_anchors.model_observable: charged fraction + stored-work fraction vs drive and coupling
literature_anchors.source: Buckel & Thauer 2013 (flavin-based electron bifurcation / energy coupling); Lane & Martin 2010 (chemiosmotic coupling at the vent)
literature_anchors.status_in_workspace: Reproduced as explicit free-energy bookkeeping (coarse-grained reduced kinetics)

claim: A pre-ATP thioester-class carrier coupled to an exergonic geochemical drive maintains a transferable energy currency under endergonic load (charged fraction ~0.39) and captures ~47% of the tapped geochemical free energy as stored usable work; removing the coupling or starving the drive below the carrier bond collapses the currency — capturing free energy into a transferable store is an explicit, bounded, falsifiable transition, not a favourable reaction direction.
result: Favourable arm maintains the currency (final charged fraction 0.39 >= 0.25) and captures 0.47 of the input free energy as transferable work (>= 0.30); the no-coupling and no-drive ablations collapse to ~0; the free-energy ledger residual stays at machine precision (~1e-16 kJ/L).

findings.statement: An exergonic geochemical drive coupled to a pre-ATP thioester-class carrier builds and MAINTAINS a transferable energy currency under continuous endergonic load — the charged pool fills from empty and settles at ~39% of capacity, a spendable store held against discharge and hydrolysis. This is energetic bookkeeping (a carrier charged and spent), not a favourable reaction direction.

evidence.observed: charged fraction 0.00 -> 0.39 and held under load

findings.explanation: ProtoEnergyCurrencyProcess charges the carrier at the coupling efficiency when the drive ΔG clears the carrier bond, discharges it to endergonic work under load, and bleeds it by first-order hydrolysis; the steady charge is the balance of charging against the two drains.

findings.statement: Accounting the free energy by DESTINATION (a conserved ledger: input = useful work + stored + dissipated) shows ~47% of the tapped geochemical free energy is captured as transferable usable work at the favourable operating point, the remaining ~53% dissipated (uncoupled drive, discharge inefficiency, hydrolysis). Capture is not assumed — it is measured, bounded, and falls off smoothly as the coupling efficiency or the drive margin over the carrier bond declines.

evidence.observed: stored-work fraction 0.47 of input free energy; ledger residual ~1e-16 kJ/L

findings.explanation: The currency process emits the full ledger (input / work / stored / dissipated); the stored-work fraction is (work + stored)/input. Charging draws bond/efficiency of input per charged mole (the uncoupled remainder dissipated), so the captured fraction is bounded above by the coupling efficiency and reduced further by discharge loss and hydrolysis — rendered as the energy-provenance panel (Mechanism) and the capture landscape (Decision).

findings.statement: The currency collapses under either ablation — no coupling (efficiency -> 0) OR a drive ΔG below the carrier's high-energy bond — so capturing environmental free energy into a transferable store requires BOTH a coupling chemistry and a drive strong enough to clear the bond. The drive axis has a real thermodynamic gate, not merely a rate dependence; the Decision phase map is the bounded region where both conditions hold.

evidence.observed: favourable charged fraction 0.39 vs no-coupling 0.00 / no-drive 0.00

findings.explanation: A carrier can only be charged when the drive ΔG exceeds the bond energy (a weak drive cannot charge a high-energy carrier) and the coupling actually transfers it; below either threshold no store builds, so the viable region is bounded on both axes.

report.title: Proto-energetics — an energy currency before modern pumping
report.verdict: PASS — a transferable currency is captured and maintained in a bounded region; ~47% of geochemical free energy becomes stored usable work
report.main_insight: A pre-ATP carrier coupled to an exergonic geochemical drive captures environmental free energy into a transferable, spendable currency — maintained under load only where the drive clears the carrier bond and the coupling is efficient enough, with a measured (not assumed) stored-work fraction of ~47%.
report.conclusion: The energy-currency bookkeeping shows the missing pre-modern transition: an exergonic geochemical drive is captured into a transferable store (thioester / acyl-phosphate class) that does endergonic work, before any modern-style ion pumping. It sits BEFORE og-05's internalized gradient generation in the campaign logic — owning a spendable energy currency is the prerequisite the later pumping stage internalizes.
report.caveat: Coarse-grained deterministic reduced kinetics (a free-energy ledger with textbook carrier-bond anchors), not a wrapped quantum-chemistry / MD engine. The carrier-bond energies are order-of-magnitude literature anchors.

biological_validation.basis: Reproduces the pre-ATP energy-currency concept (Buckel & Thauer 2013; Lane & Martin 2010) — an exergonic drive captured into a transferable carrier that does endergonic work, with capture gated by the drive-vs-bond thermodynamics.

explanatory_gain.basis: The free-energy ledger explains both WHERE a currency is viable (the bounded drive x efficiency region) and HOW MUCH geochemical free energy becomes usable work (the stored-work fraction), from explicit bookkeeping rather than assumption.

limitations: Coarse-grained deterministic reduced kinetics with textbook carrier-bond anchors; not a wrapped quantum-chemistry / MD engine.
A single carrier at a time (thioester default); the cross-carrier comparison (acyl-phosphate / polyphosphate / reduced-metal) is available via the carrier parameter but not swept here.

resolved_uncertainties: A primitive system can capture environmental free energy into a transferable currency, and the captured fraction is bounded and measurable (~47% at the favourable point).
Capture requires both a coupling chemistry and a drive that clears the carrier bond (both ablations collapse).
remaining_uncertainties: Which primitive coupling chemistry (thioester vs acyl-phosphate vs polyphosphate vs reduced-metal) best supports synthesis / transport / maintenance under realistic drives.
How the stored-work fraction trades against turnover when the endergonic load spectrum (synthesis / transport / maintenance) is resolved.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Sweep the carrier type and the load spectrum to rank the primitive coupling chemistries for synthesis / transport / maintenance.
